authors: Gagliardi L., Evangelisti S., Barone V., Roos B.O.

species.method: CASPT2 / 3s2p1d ANO basis (also SCF/vdzp, MP2/vdzp, DFT/vdzp, DFT/vtzp reported)

species.notes: LIKELY THE SAME SPECIES as N5-N6-abinitio.pdf's 'N6_C2h_trans_diazide' (independent characterization, different method/basis, reasonably consistent bond lengths -- cross-check both during dedup, may want to keep both as independent literature confirmations rather than merge outright).

species.method: CASPT2 / 3s2p1d ANO basis, assumed C2v symmetry
